comparator.name: Pharmacy (Farmacie)
comparator.sourceNotes: The selected Farmacie pathway closes 60+60+60 with 135 EC of required major study and 45 EC of genuine profiling. The selected 7.5-EC thesis is counted once; the authorized 15-EC alternative would instead produce 142.5 EC major and 37.5 EC profiling and is not stacked. Zero-credit Academic Skills requirements remain required but do not add credit, and FA-BA107 credit release depends on FA-BA10017. Formal programme instruction is Dutch plus English while all 18 checked selected course offerings list Dutch.
